welcome.title: Welcome to Wager! [Deutsch]
welcome.subtitle: Let's get your pay tracking set up in under 2 minutes. [Deutsch]
welcome.description: We need a few quick details to calculate your earnings accurately: [Deutsch]

trackPay.title: Track Pay [Deutsch]
trackPay.description: Calculate standard pay, 6-day bonuses, and performance bonuses automatically [Deutsch]

weeklyCalendar.title: Weekly Calendar [Deutsch]
weeklyCalendar.description: Log work days, sweeps, and mileage with an intuitive calendar view [Deutsch]

vanTracking.title: Van Tracking [Deutsch]
vanTracking.description: Track van hire costs, deposits, and mileage discrepancies [Deutsch]

customizable.title: Customizable [Deutsch]
customizable.description: Adjust rates, mileage, and settings to match your DSP's pay structure [Deutsch]

payRates.title: Your Daily Pay Rates [Deutsch]
payRates.subtitle: These rates are used to calculate your weekly earnings [Deutsch]

disclaimer.title: Not sure about your rates? [Deutsch]
disclaimer.description: Check with your manager to confirm your exact daily rates. You can always update these later in Settings. [Deutsch]

invoicing.title: Invoicing Service [Deutsch]
invoicing.subtitle: Choose how you handle invoicing and accounting [Deutsch]

selfInvoicing.label: Self-Invoicing
selfInvoicing.description: Handle your own invoicing and tax returns [Deutsch]

invoicing.info: This affects your weekly deductions. You can change this anytime in Settings. [Deutsch]

vanHire.title: Do you have a van on hire? [Deutsch]
vanHire.subtitle: We can help you track van costs, deposits, and mileage [Deutsch]
vanHire.yesDescription: Set up van hire details and start tracking costs [Deutsch]
vanHire.noDescription: I don't have a van or I'll add it later [Deutsch]
vanHire.info: You can add or manage van hires anytime from the Van Management page [Deutsch]

vanHireForm.title: Add Your Van Hire [Deutsch]
vanHireForm.subtitle: Enter your van details to start tracking costs and deposits [Deutsch]
vanHireForm.vanTypeFleetHelp: Fixed rate rental van at £250 per week [Deutsch]
vanHireForm.vanTypeFlexiHelp: Company van with variable weekly cost (£100-250) [Deutsch]
vanHireForm.onHireDateHelp: When did you start hiring this van? [Deutsch]
vanHireForm.depositInfo: We'll automatically track your deposit payments (£25 for your first 2 pay cheques, then £50 per pay cheque until you reach £500 total). [Deutsch]

success.title: You're All Set! 🎉 [Deutsch]
success.subtitle: Your pay tracking is ready to go. Here's what you can do: [Deutsch]

calendar.title: Calendar [Deutsch]
calendar.description: Track daily work, sweeps, and mileage with a visual weekly view [Deutsch]

dashboard.title: Dashboard [Deutsch]
dashboard.description: Quick adds for work, sweeps, and odometer readings. See payment breakdowns. [Deutsch]

vanManagement.title: Van Management [Deutsch]
vanManagement.description: Track van hire costs, deposits, and off-hire dates [Deutsch]

settings.title: Settings [Deutsch]
settings.description: Customize rates, mileage, and invoicing service anytime [Deutsch]

tour.title: Want to see how it works first? [Deutsch]
tour.description: Take a quick guided tour of the dashboard to explore all features [Deutsch]

dashboardQuickAddWork.title: Quick Add Work [Deutsch]
dashboardQuickAddWork.description: Add today's work quickly from the dashboard. Select your route type and the app auto-calculates your daily rate. [Deutsch]

dashboardPayment.title: Payment This Week [Deutsch]
dashboardPayment.description: See your expected bank deposit with full breakdown. This shows Week N-2 standard pay plus Week N-6 performance bonus. [Deutsch]

dashboardVanStatus.title: Van Status [Deutsch]
dashboardVanStatus.description: Track your van deposit progress and weekly costs. See how much you've paid and how much remains to reach £500. [Deutsch]

calendarNavigation.title: Week Navigation [Deutsch]
calendarNavigation.description: Navigate between weeks to view past and future work. Use Previous, Today, and Next buttons or jump to a specific week. [Deutsch]

calendarDayCell.title: Day Cells [Deutsch]
calendarDayCell.description: Click any day to view details or add work. Each cell shows route type, pay, sweeps, and mileage at a glance. [Deutsch]

calendarWeekSummary.title: Week Summary [Deutsch]
calendarWeekSummary.description: Full pay breakdown including base pay, 6-day bonus, sweeps, mileage, and van costs. Enter performance rankings here too. [Deutsch]

calendarPaymentThisWeek.title: Payment This Week [Deutsch]
calendarPaymentThisWeek.description: See what's hitting your bank account this week. Standard pay from 2 weeks ago plus performance bonus from 6 weeks ago. [Deutsch]

vanManagementTop.title: Van Management - Add & Track [Deutsch]
vanManagementTop.description: Use this top section to add new van hires and track your deposit progress. The deposit tracker shows how much you've paid and what remains. [Deutsch]

vanManagementBottom.title: Van Management - Van History [Deutsch]
vanManagementBottom.description: View all your van hires here. See active vans, off-hired vans, and manage your complete van history. [Deutsch]

tourComplete.title: Ready to Track Your Pay! [Deutsch]
tourComplete.description: You've completed the tour! Click the Quick Add Work tile above to log your first day, or explore at your own pace. [Deutsch]

modal.title: Onboarding Wizard [Deutsch]
modal.description: Complete the setup process to get started with Wager [Deutsch]

toast.vanAddFailed: Failed to add van hire. You can add it later from Van Management. [Deutsch]
toast.welcomeMessage: Welcome to Wager! Start tracking your pay. [Deutsch]
toast.savingSettingsFailed: Failed to save settings. Please try again. [Deutsch]
